messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick check — Acme onboarding final acceptance is tomorrow. Need to confirm the SLOs we'll present during the handoff (uptime, P99 latency) and the credits calc. Agenda: thresholds, evidence bundle owner, comms owner.

Jonas (Ops Lead): Are we sticking with 99.95% uptime + P99 < 200ms? I remember legal asking about 99.9 for some customers.

Priya (Onboarding): Contract excerpt I have shows 99.95% in section 4.1 for Dedicated customers. We did offer a temporary 99.9 concession in pre-sale for quicker acceptance, but that was verbal.

Cassandra (Legal): Confirming: master contract = 99.95 baseline. Appendix B has credit table. Any deviation from the contract needs approvals and an amendment.

Samir (SRE): Ops will own the evidence bundle. Plan: perf dashboard export + P99 traces + rolling SLO calc CSV. I'll upload by 09:30 PT tomorrow. Link will be posted here.

Maya (CSM): Perfect. Can someone prep a one-page FAQ explaining how credits are calculated? Customer asked last week and got confused by warmup vs outage windows.

Priya (Onboarding): I can draft the FAQ. Quick Q: do we exclude prefix/KV cache misses from the SLO calc or is everything included post-ingestion?

Samir (SRE): SLO window is 30d rolling and includes all customer requests after ingestion. Caching/kv isn't excluded. We do exclude scheduled maintenance windows (we'll note planned windows in the bundle). I'll add a short section in the export showing cache-hit ratio so CS can explain impact.

Jonas (Ops Lead): Renewal risk item: account health score is 72. If handoff + clear SLO docs gets them to >=80, Sales has a much higher chance at on-time renewal. @Tom (Sales) — can you join handoff?

Maya (CSM): Yes, scheduling enablement session with their infra team Wed 10am PT. I'll include runbook overview and how to read the SLO dashboard. Also collecting 3 quick feedback questions to send right after the call.

Priya (Onboarding): Draft FAQ ETA: EOD today for review. Will include example credit calculation and a tiny snippet: 
```
Credits = max(0, floor((Target - Observed)/Target * CreditCap))
Example: Target 99.95 -> Observed 99.80 => creditX
```

Samir (SRE): Evidence export path I'll use: gs://redwood-evidence/acme/1766001122/ — will put dashboard CSV, p99-traces.jsonl, and maintenance.log. Upload by 09:30 PT.

Cassandra (Legal): Once FAQ is drafted, please cc me. If anything suggests a permanent SLA change we need to start paperwork. For one-off onboarding clarifications it's fine to send explanatory docs.

SLA-bot: Scheduled maintenance reminder: none within the next 48h for Acme. (automated)

Maya (CSM): Thanks all. Plan: Priya uploads FAQ, Samir uploads evidence, I run handoff Wed 10am PT and send feedback poll. If we get the score to 80+ by next week we flag renewal as green.

Tom (Sales): Noted — I'll join the handoff and follow up on renewal play if CS nails it.

Maya (CSM): Ok team, last ask: when you upload, drop the permalink here and I'll add it to the customer packet. :pray:
